capabilities: Convert Markdown notes to WeChat Official Account compatible HTML
Upload notes to the WeChat draft box or publish them directly
Upload local images and Obsidian internal-link images to WeChat servers
Preview the WeChat rendering of the current note in a sidebar panel
View, manage, and delete drafts and published articles
extras: Bilingual (Chinese/English) README; the repository also includes standalone Python command-line tools for the same conversion and publishing tasks; content management requires completed personal authentication on the WeChat platform; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; notes that preview may differ from the final published result due to WeChat editor style restrictions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to WeChat Official Accounts, including converting to platform-compatible HTML, uploading local images, and applying WeChat-specific styling.
